tabs.tab1_description:
9 mukhi Nepalese Rudraksha opens up the Sahasrara chakra which is the energy center that establishes our connection with the Universe, tuning us to the highest form of Consciousness. It is associated with power, dynamism, courage and fearlessness. It provides the wearer with protection against negativity, fear, ego, hatred, prejudice, selfishness and jealousy. As per Vedic astrology, 9 Mukhi Rudraksha is associated with Rahu and provides clarity, emotional stability and material, mental and spiritual progress. Goddess Durga is Shakti in charge of the cosmos or physical universe and Sahasrara chakra is a being’s inner connection with the Whole. By wearing 9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha one’s attain the highest form of Consciousness beyond this material world, which becomes now under the command of the wearer. Such a powerful Rudraksha rules over all kinds of enemies and makes the wearer positive, dynamic and fearless. It blesses with bravery, courage, endurance and name and fame. It helps to build and enhance connection with goddess Durga which can revert one’s past karma and move beyond time and space towards ultimate enlightenment. The 9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha regulates the function of the brain and the central nervous system, thus it has the potential to effectively cure and heal numerous physical ailments. Also, it brings to balance various mental conditions by killing the demons of the mind.

According to the Rudraksha Jabalo Upanishad, the 9 mukhi Rudraksha possesses the spectacular powers of all nine goddesses or navadurgas. This Rudraksha is also blessed by Kaal Bhairav. Hence, the wearer of this Rudraksha bead does not fear the time (Kaal). This Rudraksha when worn correctly manifests qualities of courage, fearlessness and dynamism along with material accomplishments.

Scriptural Reference of 9 mukhi Rudraksha

Shiva Purana. Chapter 25, Slokas 74-75.

Bhairavo navavaktrashcha kapilashcha munih smritah |
Durga va tadadhishthatri navarupa maheshvari || 74 ||
Rudraksha with nine faces is said to be the form of Bhairav and Kapilamuni. Its Adhisthatri deity is Godess Durga, the devi who takes nine forms.

Tam dharayedwamahaste Rudraksham bhaktitatparah |
Sarveshvaro bhawenunam mama tulyo na samshayah || 75 ||
This nine faced Rudraksha is to be worn with respect on the left hand. There is no doubt the person who wears it will become almighty and of my level. esvari Herself. That Rudraksha shall be worn on the left hand with great devotion. He shall certainly become Sarvesvara like me.

Padma Purana, Chapter 59, Verses 180b–183a:

अष्टवक्त्रः सेनापतिर् विनायकः सदा स्मृतः।
यः पुमान् धारयेन्नित्यं तस्य दोषा न विद्यते॥
...
नववक्त्रः स्मृतो भैरवः।
यस्तु ताम्रां रुद्राक्षां नवमुखीं धारयेत् भुजि।
स मे तुल्यो भवेत् शक्त्या मुक्तिदा सा सदा स्मृता॥
कोटिकोटि सहस्राणि यो हन्ति पुरुषाधमः।
सर्वं दग्ध्वा क्षणेनैव नववक्त्रं धारयन् नरः॥
स्वर्गे देवैः सदा पूज्यः शक्रवत् स्यात् न संशयः।
गणेशोऽपि सदा तस्य श्रेष्ठे स्थाने निवसति॥

Translation: The nine-mouthed Rudraksha is known as Bhairava. Whoever wears this tawny nine-faced Rudraksha on the arm becomes equal to me (Shiva) in power. It is always regarded as granting liberation. Even if a most wicked person kills thousands of crores of beings, all those sins are instantly destroyed by wearing a Rudraksha with nine faces. In heaven, he is always honored by the gods like Indra, and Ganesha himself resides with him in an excellent abode.

Devi Bhagavata Purana, Skandha 11, Adhyaya 3, Verses 32–33:

नवमुखो भैरवः साक्षात् पापघ्नः पुण्यवर्धनः।
वामभुजे तु धार्यः स्यात् सर्वपापक्षयप्रदः॥
धारयित्वा नरः प्राज्ञो भोगमोक्षफलप्रदः।
शिवतुल्यबलोपेतः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥

Translation: The nine-faced Rudraksha is verily Bhairava, the destroyer of sins and the increaser of merit. It should be worn on the left arm and destroys all sins. The wise person who wears it attains both enjoyment and liberation, becomes endowed with power equal to Shiva, and is freed from all sins.

tabs.tab4_description:
How to identify original 9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Some fraudulent tests have gained popularity and must be avoided because their results are unreliable and they cannot be used to determine the authenticity of Rudraksha.

The Fake tests are the Water Test, Milk test or Copper Coin Rotation Test. All these tests are unscientific and produce untrustworthy results.

One way to determine the originality of Rudraksha beads is to take an X-ray. In an X-ray, the compartment and seeds inside the Rudraksha are observable, and their number should ideally correspond to the number of Mukhi lines on the bead. Sometimes all seeds are not visible as they get compressed during formation and compartments are very close to each other, though.

Experts at Rudra Centre can examine the bead and determine if they are original or not. You can send us images and videos of your Rudraksha at the email: contact@rudracentre.com for our experts to determine authenticity.

In recent years many labs have emerged which offer Rudraksha certification however these are highly unreliable because they do not have the right knowledge and many times make mistakes in identifying Rudraksha beads. Many traders are using these labs to issue fake certificates. These labs are not able to distinguish manipulated beads where extra lines are carved on the Rudraksha to make it a higher mukhi which costs more. Also, they do not reject beads with incomplete mukhi lines which actually don’t give results. These labs are not affiliated with any central body or government, so they do not have any credibility. Hence to protect consumers Rudra Centre has opened its own laboratory and have started issuing genuine certificate where all parameters of the Rudraksha are analyzed. We examine whether the beads are healthy, whether the mukhi lines are complete, and whether the rudraksha beads has been manipulated.

At Rudra Centre, we issue certificates for all beads procured from us. If you want an X-ray certificate for the Rudraksha bead, then an additional INR 500 is charged per Rudraksha bead.

How to Clean & Maintain 9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Rudraksha beads can last a lifetime and be passed down through generations if cared for properly.

In cold and dry climates, rudraksha beads may develop surface-level cracks, in which case any natural unscented oil may be applied, such as olive oil, sandal oil, or cow ghee.

Rudraksha may develop molds and insects if they are kept in a humid place and unused for a long time, in this case follow the below steps:

  • Dip the Rudraksha beads in lukewarm water for 15 mins.
  • Clean any molds visible of the surface using a toothbrush.
  • Dry them under the shade of the Sun (indirect Sunlight) or you can also use a dryer or hairdryer.
  • After following the above steps, you can start wearing your rudraksha beads or combination again.

Follow the steps below to regularly clean your Rudraksha beads:

  • Wash Rudraksha beads under running water.
  • Scrub the surface of the rudraksha to remove any dust particles caught in the grooves, using a toothbrush.
  • Use the shade of the Sun (indirect sunlight) or a hairdryer to dry the beads.
  • Apply any natural and unscented oil like Olive oil, Almond oil or Sandal oil.
  • If you are planning to not wear beads for a long duration, it is advisable to keep them in the fridge.
  • Do not use any chemical cleaner or insecticide or pesticide to clean or treat your Rudraksha.
  • Do not put your rudraksha beads in boiling water or extremely hot water.

9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha Health & Color

9 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha will become darker overtime with usage because it is exposed to oil, sweat and the environment, this is a natural process and doesn’t affect the energy of the Rudraksha bead. It is best to choose a light Sandy Brown to Brown color Rudraksha bead as it generally means the bead is healthy and freshly (recently) harvested. It is advised to avoid wearing dark black or dark grey color beads as they may be lifeless. To check if the bead is healthy and alive just shake the bead well and if you hear the seeds inside rattling then it means that the bead is lifeless or dead and if there is no rattling sound then the bead is healthy and alive. You can inspect the bead from all sides and look inside the natural hole to ensure that there are no white color molds or insects which have infested the bead. Sometimes the soap gets stuck in the grooves, which are white in color; therefore, you should determine whether the white deposits are soap or mold. The mold will appear as threads whereas the soap deposits will be like a cream or paste. The energy of the Rudraksha beads resides is in its seeds, thus we must ensure that the seeds are healthy and alive.
